# edjelley.com

> A comprehensive fountain pen, ink, and stationery review site by Ed Jelley featuring product reviews, beginner guides, and curated recommendations for writing instrument enthusiasts.

edjelley.com is a specialized review publication focused on fountain pens, inks, and stationery products. The site combines beginner-friendly guides, product recommendations across price points, and detailed reviews of both established brands (Lamy, Pilot, Esterbrook) and emerging products from Kickstarter campaigns and independent makers.

## Key Topics

- fountain pens
- ink reviews
- stationery
- pen recommendations
- beginner guides
- Lamy
- Pilot
- product reviews
- mechanical pencils
- Kickstarter campaigns
- pen collecting
- writing instruments
- notebook paper
- everyday carry
- pen blogger

## Core Pages

- [edjelley.com – Fountain Pen, Ink, and Stationery Reviews](http://edjelley.com): Homepage for Ed Jelley's fountain pen, ink, and stationery reviews
- [The List – edjelley.com](https://edjelley.com/thelist): Indexed catalog of all fountain pen, ink, and stationery reviews
- [About – edjelley.com](https://edjelley.com/about): About Ed Jelley and the mission of edjelley.com reviews

## Beginner Guides & Getting Started

- [Everything You Need To Start Writing With Fountain Pens](https://edjelley.com/2016/07/02/the-ultimate-gift-guide-for-the-fountain-pen-fanatic): Beginner's guide to starter fountain pens and supplies
- [Top 7 Beginner Fountain Pens Under $25](https://edjelley.com/2015/06/03/7-best-beginner-fountain-pens-under-25-dollars): Budget fountain pen recommendations including Lamy Safari and Kaweco
- [3 Best Beginner Fountain Pen Kits (At Any Price!)](https://edjelley.com/2016/03/11/3-best-beginner-fountain-pen-kits-at-any-price): Beginner fountain pen kits at different price points with J. Herbin ink
- [8 Reasons Why You Should Write With a Fountain Pen](https://edjelley.com/2016/06/02/8-reasons-why-you-should-write-with-a-fountain-pen): Article on benefits of fountain pens including sustainability

## Product Reviews & Recommendations

- [The Best Fountain Pens for Taking Notes](https://edjelley.com/2017/07/10/the-best-fountain-pens-for-taking-notes): Guide to fountain pens for note-taking including Lamy 2000, Pilot VP
- [6 Japanese Fountain Pens To Help You Write Really Small](https://edjelley.com/2017/02/17/6-japanese-fountain-pens-to-help-you-write-really-small): Review of fine nib Japanese pens like Pilot Metropolitan and Custom 74
- [The Best Fountain Pen Friendly Notebooks](https://edjelley.com/2016/07/28/the-best-fountain-pen-friendly-notebooks): Recommendations for notebook paper quality including Tomoe River
- [Esterbrook x Accutron Fountain Pen Review](https://edjelley.com/2021/02/09/esterbrook-x-accutron-fountain-pen-review): Review of vintage brand collaboration pen with Schmidt medium nib
- [Modern Fuel Adjustable Bolt Action Pen PROTOTYPE PREVIEW](https://edjelley.com/2021/05/11/modern-fuel-adjustable-bolt-action-pen-prototype-preview): Early prototype review of Modern Fuel's adjustable bolt action pen
- [Wingback Mechanical Pencil Kickstarter Review](https://edjelley.com/2021/03/31/wingback-mechanical-pencil-kickstarter-review): Kickstarter review of brass Wingback mechanical pencil by Tim Pockett
